# Gitea

> Gitea is a painless, self-hosted, all-in-one software development service: Git hosting, code review, issues and projects, CI/CD (Gitea Actions), and package registries. It is open source (MIT), written in Go, ships as a single binary or container image, and runs on Linux, macOS, Windows, and ARM.

The canonical documentation lives at https://docs.gitea.com (this file indexes the current stable version; versioned docs are available under /1.24/, /1.23/, and /next/ path prefixes). The REST API of any Gitea instance is self-describing: interactive Swagger UI at `{instance}/api/swagger` and the machine-readable OpenAPI spec at `{instance}/swagger.v1.json`.

## Getting started

- [Documentation home](https://docs.gitea.com/): overview of Gitea and the full docs tree
- [Comparison to other Git hosting](https://docs.gitea.com/installation/comparison/): feature-by-feature comparison with GitHub, GitLab, and others
- [Install with Docker](https://docs.gitea.com/installation/install-with-docker/): the most common setup, with compose examples and databases
- [Install with Docker (rootless)](https://docs.gitea.com/installation/install-with-docker-rootless/): rootless container image setup
- [Install from binary](https://docs.gitea.com/installation/install-from-binary/): single-binary install on Linux/macOS/Windows
- [Install from package](https://docs.gitea.com/installation/install-from-package/): distribution package managers (apt, brew, snap, ...)
- [Install from source](https://docs.gitea.com/installation/install-from-source/): building Gitea yourself with Go
- [Install on Kubernetes](https://docs.gitea.com/installation/install-on-kubernetes/): Helm chart deployment
- [Install on a cloud provider](https://docs.gitea.com/installation/install-on-cloud-provider/): one-click images and marketplace installs
- [Database preparation](https://docs.gitea.com/installation/database-prep/): PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite setup before first run
- [Run as a Linux service](https://docs.gitea.com/installation/linux-service/): systemd/supervisor configuration
- [Run as a Windows service](https://docs.gitea.com/installation/windows-service/): Windows service registration
- [Upgrading Gitea](https://docs.gitea.com/installation/upgrade-from-gitea/): safe upgrade procedure between versions

## Administration

- [Config cheat sheet](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/config-cheat-sheet/): every app.ini setting, the single most useful admin reference
- [Command line](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/command-line/): the `gitea` CLI (admin users, generate, dump, doctor, ...)
- [Environment variables](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/environment-variables/): env-based configuration, including GITEA__section__KEY overrides
- [Authentication](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/authentication/): LDAP, PAM, SMTP, FreeIPA, and reverse-proxy auth sources
- [Email setup](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/email-setup/): outgoing mail configuration
- [Reverse proxies](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/reverse-proxies/): nginx, Apache, Caddy, Traefik examples
- [HTTPS setup](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/https-setup/): TLS certificates and ACME/Let's Encrypt
- [Backup and restore](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/backup-and-restore/): `gitea dump` and full-instance recovery
- [Logging configuration](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/logging-config/): log outputs, levels, and rotation
- [Customizing Gitea](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/customizing-gitea/): templates, themes, landing pages, custom files
- [Repository indexer](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/repo-indexer/): enabling code search
- [Git LFS setup](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/git-lfs-setup/): large file storage configuration
- [GPG commit signing](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/signing/): instance-side commit signing
- [Fail2ban setup](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/fail2ban-setup/): brute-force protection
- [Embedded assets extraction](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/cmd-embedded/): listing and overriding embedded templates/assets
- [Mail templates](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/mail-templates/): customizing notification emails
- [Search engine indexation](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/search-engines-indexation/): robots.txt control for public instances
- [External renderers](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/external-renderers/): rendering Jupyter notebooks, asciidoc, and other formats
- [Adding legal pages](https://docs.gitea.com/administration/adding-legal-pages/): ToS/privacy pages for public instances

## Using Gitea

- [Webhooks](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/repository/webhooks/): event payloads and supported webhook targets
- [Repository migration](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/repository/migration/): importing repos (with issues/PRs/releases) from GitHub, GitLab, and others
- [Repository mirroring](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/repository/repo-mirror/): push and pull mirrors
- [Push options and features](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/repository/push/): push-to-create, push options, and related tricks
- [Clone filters](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/repository/clone-filters/): partial clones for large repositories
- [Code owners](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/repository/code-owners/): CODEOWNERS-based review routing
- [Template repositories](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/repository/template-repositories/): repo templates with variable substitution
- [Profile READMEs](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/repository/profile-readme/): user/org profile pages
- [Markdown support](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/repository/markdown/): flavor and extensions Gitea renders
- [Incoming email](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/repository/incoming-email/): replying to issues/PRs by email
- [Pull requests](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/issues-prs/pull-request/): PR workflow, merge styles, and review features
- [Issue & PR templates](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/issues-prs/issue-pull-request-templates/): YAML and markdown templates
- [Labels](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/issues-prs/labels/): label management, incl. scoped labels
- [Automatically linked references](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/issues-prs/automatically-linked-references/): issue/commit cross-linking syntax
- [Merge message templates](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/issues-prs/merge-message-templates/): customizing merge commit messages
- [AGit flow](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/issues-prs/agit/): creating PRs by push, without a fork
- [Permissions](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/access-control/permissions/): user/org/team permission model
- [Protected branches](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/access-control/protected-branches/): branch protection rules and status checks
- [Protected tags](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/access-control/protected-tags/): tag protection patterns
- [Blocking users](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/access-control/blocking-user/): moderation controls
- [Multi-factor authentication](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/user-setting/multi-factor-authentication/): TOTP and security keys

## CI/CD (Gitea Actions)

- [Actions overview](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/actions/overview/): the built-in, GitHub-Actions-compatible CI/CD system
- [Actions quickstart](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/actions/quickstart/): first workflow end to end
- [Act runner](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/actions/runner/): installing and registering the runner
- [Actions design](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/actions/design/): architecture and how it differs internally
- [Comparison with GitHub Actions](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/actions/comparison/): compatibility notes and unsupported syntax
- [Actions variables](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/actions/actions-variables/): repo/org/user-level variables
- [Actions secrets](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/actions/secrets/): secret management for workflows
- [Status badges](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/actions/badge/): workflow badge URLs
- [Scoped workflows](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/actions/scoped-workflows/): global/org-level workflows
- [Token permissions](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/actions/token-permissions/): the GITEA_TOKEN permission model
- [Actions FAQ](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/actions/faq/): common questions and gotchas
- [Runner documentation](https://docs.gitea.com/runner/): act_runner docs (installation, registration, configuration, labels, monitoring)

## Package registries

- [Packages overview](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/packages/overview/): the built-in package registry (30+ formats) and how auth works
- [Storage](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/packages/storage/): deduplication and storage backends for packages
- [Container registry](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/packages/container/): OCI/Docker images
- [npm](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/packages/npm/): npm registry usage
- [PyPI](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/packages/pypi/): Python package registry usage
- [Cargo](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/packages/cargo/): Rust crate registry usage
- [Go](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/packages/go/): Go module proxy usage
- [Maven](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/packages/maven/): Java package registry usage
- [NuGet](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/packages/nuget/): .NET package registry usage
- [Debian](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/packages/debian/): apt repository usage
- [RPM](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/packages/rpm/): yum/dnf repository usage
- [Generic](https://docs.gitea.com/usage/packages/generic/): arbitrary file publishing via HTTP

## API & integrations

- [API usage](https://docs.gitea.com/development/api-usage/): REST API basics, tokens, pagination, and the OpenAPI/Swagger endpoints
- [API reference](https://docs.gitea.com/api/): browsable reference generated from the OpenAPI spec (machine-readable spec at `{instance}/swagger.v1.json`)
- [OAuth2 provider](https://docs.gitea.com/development/oauth2-provider/): using Gitea as an OAuth2/OIDC identity provider
- [Integrations](https://docs.gitea.com/development/integrations/): SDKs, editors, CI systems, and third-party tools that speak Gitea
- [Migration interfaces](https://docs.gitea.com/development/migrations-interfaces/): the downloader/uploader interfaces behind repo migration
